summary: Tested grouped Knowledge Base APIs and UI against the public Preview URL and target workspace. All 7 core backend tests passed: the 10-part Lace scrape is one row, metadata is correct, group category/toggle/priority work, single-source category works, categories are unique, and group delete removed every generated RFC chunk. Four validation/error-handling tests failed. The full desktop UI flow passed, including 3-row rendering, inline category save/cancel, filtering, grouped toggle/priority calls, metadata, and tabs. Mobile layout has severe horizontal overflow.

minor.issue: A nonexistent group returns HTTP 200 with success:true instead of 404; reproduced with group_id TEST_missing.
A nonexistent group returns HTTP 200 with success:true instead of 404; matched_count is not checked.
A nonexistent source returns HTTP 200 with success:true instead of 404; matched_count is not checked.
Priority accepts out-of-range values such as 99 and persists them, although the product supports only 0, 1, and 2.

issues: Page width expands to 1055px for a 390px viewport. The fixed 250px sidebar and desktop-width content leave the heading, forms, source metadata, and row actions off-screen with severe horizontal overflow.

action_items: Return 404 when category/priority mutation targets match no source or group.
Constrain PriorityUpdate.priority to the supported 0..2 range with Pydantic validation and apply the same validation to all source creation/update paths.
Add a responsive/collapsible admin sidebar and stack or horizontally contain KB source rows on narrow viewports.
Expose visible loading/error states when knowledge source or category loading fails instead of swallowing API errors.
critical_code_review_comments: Category endpoints accept an untyped raw dict and silently coerce missing/null category to an empty string; define a Pydantic request model and validate payload type/length.
Group category/priority and single category endpoints return success without checking matched_count, which causes false-positive mutation responses.
KnowledgeBase.loadSources catches both API failures with empty handlers, so an outage is indistinguishable from an empty knowledge base.
server.py is 3606 lines and should be split into focused routers/services; knowledge grouping and scraper code should be isolated for safer validation and testing.

success_rate.backend: 64% (7/11; all 7 requested core behaviors passed, 4 validation tests failed)
success_rate.frontend: 92% (full desktop feature flow passed; mobile responsiveness failed)

seed_data_creation: Created one temporary TEST_Grouped_JSON_RFC multi-chunk URL group from RFC 8259, exercised all group mutations, and deleted every part through the group delete endpoint. Temporarily assigned TEST_UI_Category to the seeded password FAQ and removed it. All seeded priorities and active states were restored; the workspace ended with its original 3 grouped rows.
test_credentials: Loaded administrator credentials from /app/memory/test_credentials.md; public Preview login succeeded.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Desktop E2E passed on Preview - Cardano USDCx: exactly Lace FAQ (10 parts), Ableton Core Library, and How to reset password render. Added data-testid=save-category-btn and cancel-category-btn to the inline editor. Backend JUnit intentionally contains four failing negative tests for phantom-success mutations and unbounded priority. Re-test those four plus a 390px viewport after fixes.
rca_of_the_issue: The three phantom-success responses are caused by ignoring MongoDB matched_count after update_many/update_one. PriorityUpdate declares a plain int with no ge/le constraint, so 99 passes Pydantic and is persisted. Mobile overflow is caused by the permanently fixed 250px sidebar plus a desktop-oriented flex source row with multiple non-shrinking control columns and no narrow-screen breakpoint.
